input.quote: Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay obligation, shortfall penalty or volume commitment on us. Section 11 simply requires payment of "the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule" for the licence and services actually taken; maintenance under Section 10 runs "[f]or a renewable one-year term" rather than a fixed multi-year commitment; and Section 17(b) lets us terminate at any time on 90 days' notice. Searches for "minimum", "commit", "take or pay" and "shortfall" returned nothing relevant (the only "commitment" hit is the no-agency clause at p0143), and Section 3 contains only ordinary use restrictions, not caps on our purchase or usage volumes. This meets the preferred position (fees for usage or ordered services only), so no redline is warranted.
